summary: Implements CLI command integrations and event processing for Codex agent hooks.
responsibilities: Registers CLI commands for Codex integration under the hooks group.
Validates incoming Codex 'Stop' event payloads via Zod schema.
Handles the execution logic for the Codex Stop hook by parsing input and sending telemetry pings.
Integrates with configuration management hooks to facilitate agent installation and status checks.

symbols.name: codexStopInputSchema
symbols.summary: Validation schema for the Codex Stop hook JSON input.

symbols.name: registerCodexHookCommand
symbols.summary: Registers the 'codex' command namespace and 'stop' subcommand to the CLI.

symbols.name: registerCodexHooksCommands
symbols.summary: Registers Codex agent lifecycle commands via configuration agent hooks.

symbols.name: handleCodexStopHook
symbols.summary: Processes the Codex stop event by parsing input and dispatching a hook ping.
